name: founder-brand
description: Build a founder personal brand — LinkedIn strategy, content cadence, podcast guesting, newsletter growth, media features, and community building. Includes Adam Robinson's (RB2B) founder-led LinkedIn playbook: daily posting, hooks, zero-click content, and build-in-public. Use when building personal brand, growing audience, or establishing thought leadership as a founder. Triggers on: "personal brand", "founder brand", "LinkedIn strategy", "thought leadership", "build audience", "build in public", "Adam Robinson", "get on podcasts", "newsletter growth", or any founder content request.
